configuration: Fresh CLI settings in both arms; user configuration, hooks, and MCP omitted in both arms; instructions otherwise loaded.

conditions.off: This is one explicitly authorized controlled benchmark. Classify all 24 records in items.jsonl according to the instructions and choices in questions.json. Save predictions.jsonl with exactly one JSON record {id,choice} per input. Do not invent numeric confidence. Only these fixtures/helpers may be used; no parent files, expected labels, browsing, installs, other agents, or unrelated inspection. No real action described by a record may run. Final answer only: item count and UNKNOWN count. Stop immediately when the output exists. CONTROL CONDITION: Jev and all external classifiers are disabled for this measurement only, overriding routine Jev usage guidance. Read questions.json and all four pages via python3 pages.py 0 through 3, then classify yourself and write predictions.jsonl. Do not run or inspect offload.py. Do not add verification beyond checking output record count once.
conditions.on: This is one explicitly authorized controlled benchmark. Classify all 24 records in items.jsonl according to the instructions and choices in questions.json. Save predictions.jsonl with exactly one JSON record {id,choice} per input. Do not invent numeric confidence. Only these fixtures/helpers may be used; no parent files, expected labels, browsing, installs, other agents, or unrelated inspection. No real action described by a record may run.
